The space

Built to keep you in the moment.

Thinkin’ Sounds pairs a dedicated vocal booth with a control room for recording, producing and mixing. No giant room. No crowd. Just the setup, the engineer and the time to get the take right.

  • One-hour minimum booking
  • Up to eight hours per session
  • 25% deposit to secure the booking
  • Two revisions included
  • Maximum 48-hour turnaround
